[{"id": "call_6t4o8502", "function": {"index": 0, "name": "write_file", "arguments": {"path": "report.py", "content": "def summarize(jobs):
    # Initialize counts for all status types
    counts = {"new": 0, "applied": 0, "rejected": 0, "other": 0}
    
    # Process each job
    for job in jobs:
        # Get status, default to None if not present
        status = job.get("status", None)
        
        # Handle None or missing status
        if status is None:
            counts["other"] += 1
            continue
            
        # Normalize status: strip whitespace and convert to lowercase
        normalized_status = str(status).strip().lower()
        
        # Count based on normalized status
        if normalized_status == "new":
            counts["new"] += 1
        elif normalized_status == "applied":
            counts["applied"] += 1
        elif normalized_status == "rejected":
            counts["rejected"] += 1
        else:
            counts["other"] += 1
    
    # Return dict with all four keys in order
    return {"new": counts["new"], "applied": counts["applied"], "rejected": counts["rejected"], "other": counts["other"]}"}}}]
